h1: Lasalle Suites Hotel & Residence — More Space Than You'd Expect, with Full Kitchen, Pool and Basketball Court in Quiet Bang Na
intro: Bang Na tends to be thought of as a through-route to Suvarnabhumi Airport or the Eastern Seaboard — but for families with children at Bangkok Patana School, teams heading to events at BITEC, or anyone who needs a genuinely spacious base rather than a box-sized hotel room, Lasalle Suites Hotel & Residence is a property that regulars return to again and again. Suites run from a well-proportioned 55-sqm one-bedroom with balcony and full kitchen up to a 185-sqm five-bedroom duplex large enough for nine people — plus a basketball court, tennis court, outdoor pool and spa on the grounds. The hotel scores 8.8 out of 10 from 229 verified reviews across major platforms, with staff and cleanliness both earning 8.9. Rates start from approximately ฿1,200 per night for a one-bedroom suite.

body.html: Lasalle Suites sits on Lasalle Soi 33, a quiet residential lane off Sukhumvit 105, and the surrounding neighbourhood reflects that calm. Opening in 2007, the property is not the newest building in Bang Na, but reviewers consistently describe it as "an older building that is well maintained" — a meaningfully different thing from simply old and neglected. The soi setting means very little through traffic, which translates to genuine quiet at night, something guests who have stayed near busier roads in the area genuinely notice.

What makes the hotel stand out is the room format. All 34 suites come with a full kitchen (fridge, microwave, oven), a washer-dryer, and a private balcony. The entry-level one-bedroom suite measures a generous 55 sqm — larger than a standard superior room in most four-star Bangkok hotels. Family travellers can step up to the 110-sqm two-bedroom suite (two baths, sleeping four comfortably), and groups or larger teams have access to three-, four- and five-bedroom configurations up to 185 sqm. For extended stays or groups, splitting one large suite almost always works out cheaper per head than booking multiple standard hotel rooms nearby.
"Very spacious, clean and private. The pool is clean and the privacy is excellent. Staff are genuinely helpful. Good value for what you get."

Trip.com verified reviews award staff a score of 8.9 and cleanliness 8.9 — both of which consistently feature in written feedback. Front desk staff are praised for being friendly, English-capable, and responsive when issues arise. The outdoor pool draws repeated compliments for its cleanliness and the fact that it rarely gets crowded — described by one guest as offering "very good privacy." Beyond the pool, the grounds include a basketball court, a tennis court, a fitness room and a spa (Kalavek Wellness Spa), which together give the property a club-like feel that a plain hotel room setup cannot.

The location has specific strengths worth knowing. Bangkok Patana School is approximately 500 metres away on foot — families using Lasalle Suites as short-term accommodation during school term start or exam periods will appreciate the walk rather than a taxi. BITEC Bang Na (Bangkok's main exhibition and convention centre) is about 10 minutes by car, while Mega Bangna and IKEA are 12–15 minutes. Suvarnabhumi Airport is roughly 20–25 minutes depending on traffic. The Yellow Line BTS and BTS Udom Suk station (Sukhumvit Line) are both reachable by a short Grab ride.

Honest context for the things reviewers flag: the building's age shows in places. Some guests report air-conditioning that struggles during the hottest months of April and May, and a handful of reviews specifically mention bathroom fittings that could use updating. Arriving late at night, the soi setting — while quiet — can feel somewhat isolated, particularly if travelling alone for the first time. Breakfast is not typically included in room rates; guests rely on the hotel's restaurant, nearby street food stalls, or — most practically — the kitchen in their own suite.

Pricing runs from approximately ฿1,200–1,800 per night for a one-bedroom suite in quieter periods, rising to ฿2,200–2,800 for two-bedroom units. During major BITEC events such as Motor Expo, Metalex or THAIFEX, and over Thai public holidays, larger suites fill quickly and rates move up. If your event dates are known, booking three to four weeks out is sensible. The score of 8.8 from 229 reviews reflects a hotel that knows its audience well — families and teams who want real space, real cooking facilities and a quiet base, at a price that makes sense when you divide it by the number of people using the room.

highlights.title: Suites from 55 to 185 sqm — Full Kitchen in Every Room
highlights.text: All suites include a full kitchen, washer-dryer and private balcony. Ideal for families, teams or extended stays where cooking and doing laundry in-room saves real money.

highlights.title: Outdoor Pool + Basketball Court + Tennis Court
highlights.text: The grounds include sport facilities rarely found in mid-range Bang Na hotels. The pool draws consistent praise for cleanliness and privacy — rarely crowded.

highlights.text: Bang Na's position makes this property an ideal base for airport connections, BITEC events, Mega Bangna, IKEA and the Eastern Seaboard — without the traffic of central Bangkok.

honestSummary: Lasalle Suites is the right call for families, groups and extended-stay travellers who need real space, a working kitchen and room to breathe — the suite sizes and sports facilities beat anything at a comparable price in Bang Na. The trade-off is a building that shows its age in places, a quiet soi that requires Grab to reach public transport, and no included breakfast.
honestChecks: If you're staying one night and just need a clean bed — the kitchen suites here may be more room than you need, at a higher price than Hop Inn or Cubic Bangna. Lasalle Suites pays dividends most clearly over multi-night stays when the kitchen genuinely saves money.

If you expect a freshly renovated, contemporary-looking property — Lasalle Suites opened in 2007 and reviewers are candid that it shows. The building is well maintained, but it is not new. If modern design is a priority, look at newer Bang Na options.

If you plan to travel into central Bangkok daily — Lasalle Soi 33 has no public transport to the door. Budget for a short Grab ride to BTS Udom Suk or the Yellow Line station each time; factor that into your total trip cost.

tips.title: Match the Suite to Your Group Size
tips.body: A 2-bedroom suite (110 sqm) shared by a family of four is almost always cheaper per head than booking two separate rooms. Price both options before confirming — the difference often surprises people.

tips.title: Use the Pool Early Morning
tips.body: The outdoor pool is praised for its privacy and rarely gets busy. Early mornings before 8 am are the quietest — ideal for a proper swim before the day starts.

tips.title: Stock Up at Mega Bangna on Arrival
tips.body: Mega Bangna is about 15 minutes away and has a large supermarket. Loading up the in-room fridge on the first day means skipping the hotel restaurant most mornings and cutting food costs noticeably.

tips.title: Book Ahead for BITEC Events and Holidays
tips.body: During Motor Expo, Metalex, THAIFEX and Thai public holidays, larger suites book out well in advance and rates rise. Check the BITEC event calendar and reserve three to four weeks out if your dates are confirmed.

faqTitle: FAQ — Lasalle Suites Hotel & Residence Bangkok

faq.q: Where is Lasalle Suites Hotel & Residence and what is nearby?
faq.a: The hotel is at 19 Lasalle Soi 33, Sukhumvit 105, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260. Bangkok Patana School is approximately 500 m away on foot. BITEC Bang Na is about 10 minutes by car; Mega Bangna and IKEA are 12–15 minutes; Suvarnabhumi Airport is roughly 20–25 minutes depending on traffic.

faq.q: What room types does Lasalle Suites offer and how big are they?
faq.a: The hotel offers 34 suites across multiple configurations, from a 55-sqm one-bedroom suite with private balcony all the way up to a 185-sqm five-bedroom duplex that sleeps nine. All suites include a full kitchen, washer-dryer, and flat-screen TV.

faq.q: What facilities does Lasalle Suites have?
faq.a: The property features an outdoor pool, children's pool, basketball court, tennis court, fitness room, Kalavek Wellness Spa, restaurant, karaoke room, business centre, meeting rooms and free parking. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout.

faq.q: What does a room at Lasalle Suites cost per night?
faq.a: One-bedroom suites start from approximately ฿1,200 per night in quieter periods. Two-bedroom suites run ฿2,200–2,800. During major BITEC events and Thai public holidays, rates increase and larger suites book out early — reserve three to four weeks ahead if your dates are firm.

faq.q: Who is Lasalle Suites best suited to?
faq.a: The property works best for families with children at Bangkok Patana, teams attending BITEC events, and groups or extended-stay travellers who want significantly more space than a standard hotel room provides. The in-room kitchen and washer-dryer make multi-night stays noticeably more comfortable and cost-effective.
